_about: Hand-made corrections applied by scripts/convert-old-recipes.mts on top of the old catalogue. Each replacement must match the old text exactly once, or the conversion fails, so fixes never apply silently to the wrong thing. Logged in DECISIONS.md D-014. In an ingredient fix, "\n" in the replacement splits the line into several, and an empty replacement removes it.
